title: Houthi Attack on Skyscraper in Saudi Capital Wounds 11, Officials Say
summary_full: The people were wounded in the strike on a building in Riyadh, the Saudi authorities said. The Iran-backed militia and Saudi Arabia have been exchanging escalating attacks for weeks.
